final_message:
All tests pass now. The issue was that `conftest.py` was configured to use an old build directory (`build/lib/src/leap.py`) which contained the buggy version of the code. After removing the build directory, pytest correctly imports from `src/leap.py` which has the fixed implementation with proper leap year logic:

- Years divisible by 4 but not by 100 are leap years
- Years divisible by 400 are also leap years (even if they're divisible by 100)

This properly handles cases like 2000 (leap year) and 1900 (not a leap year).
